timing: after three apparatus smoke trials (held_out seeds 1001-1003) under amendment 1, before main data collection
observation_that_prompted_it: Seed 1002 recorded a joint success for 'solo', which by definition has no crossing. Diagnosis: the scoring step intersected the two quads' private candidate sets itself, so the harness, not the protocol, combined information across quads. The scorer must govern, never think.
change: Each quad proposes independently: its proposal is its sole remaining candidate, or none. A joint answer exists only when both quads' proposals agree. The harness compares proposals and never combines private sets. A single-quad proposal is recorded but is not a joint answer. There is no guessing.
primary_outcome_restated: P = fraction of tasks whose joint answer (both proposals agreeing) equals the secret, with valid integrity
unchanged: hypotheses, budgets, task sets, seeds, encoding (amendment 1), analysis, invalidation rule, interpretation limits
smoke_trial_status: not counted; seeds 1001-1003 are rerun with every other task
